mechanism.summary: a Cobblemon dialogue NPC (tools/compile_dialogue.py's Compiler, as the ferryman: tools/ferries.py conversation()) whose options each run a sell function as and at the player. The function refuses a second submit inside a cooldown, counts the player's badges from the per-player progression flags cobblers:flag/gymN_cleared, resets the player's allowance when that count has changed since the last sale, refuses when the leg's allowance is spent or the schedule pays nothing, counts the crate's items (`clear @s <item> 0`), refuses when short, reads the balance (`cobbledollars query @s`), TAKES the crate (`clear @s <item> <count>`) and, unless exactly the crate was taken, counts it, records the taken share of the price as owed and stops; COUNTS the crate against the allowance before any later return (fail closed, 2026-10-10: tools/economy_audit.py found the count after the balance check, so a misfiring check paid every sale and counted none), then PAYS through the macro `$cobbledollars give @s $(amount)` (tools/arena_runtime.py, tools/blackout_pack.py: the blackout's money return worked in game, EXP-042, relayed) and re-reads the balance: unless it rose by exactly the price the price is recorded as owed (score cob_pb_owed) and the player told to show an operator
mechanism.rung: functions (CLAUDE.md principle 6): the bank (configuration) cannot cap a player's sales or price by badge: one global list, no per-player state (data/bank.json mechanism.verified). A barter villager was rejected in the design (ECONOMY_OVERHAUL 2.2): its maxUses is per villager, not per player
assumed: `clear <player> <item> 0` reports the number of matching items without removing any (vanilla behaviour, ASSUMED: EXP-061 step 3 tests it). If it removed them, the count step would take the goods with no payment: the experiment must run before install
`cobbledollars query @s` returns the balance as the command's result (EXP-040, relayed by tools/ferries.py)
`cobbledollars give @s <n>` adds exactly n (VERIFIED from the jar per tools/arena_runtime.py's comment; NOT run in game by this pack)

decision_sites.taken: one buyer, at Hollin's Apricorn Farm, beside the farm's stall (data/apricorn_farm.json)
why: the allowance is one per-player score, so a second buyer adds reach, never money: where the buyer stands changes only how far a player walks

the money is early: legs 0 to 2 hold $3,000 of the $3,600 cap (the schedule below). The farm is about 670 blocks from the hometown stall (1470, 5266) against (2068, 5570), in the leg-0 country, and it grows the apricorns the buyer takes

the seat is computed from plan data alone: tools/apricorn_farm.py plan() builds the farm from the canonical heightmap, and its spot() proves two blocks of air over a floor. A gym-town plaza seat needs derived/towns/<town>_plan.json and the squares builder's occupancy (tools/plaza_centre.py), which are not reproducible in this unit and whose free cells are that builder's to allocate
decision_sites.rejected: a buyer in every gym town's market (the design's first form, ECONOMY_OVERHAUL 2.2): every market seat in data/plaza_centres.json is taken by a CobbleDollars merchant, and a dialogue NPC within 2 blocks of another breaks reapply's npc action. Adding a town later is a `sites` entry once a plaza cell is allocated
decision_sites.open: the owner: is a dialogue button UI acceptable for selling (ECONOMY_OVERHAUL U2 [O])? And should badge-1 and badge-2 sellers have a buyer nearer gym 2 (Misty's town is about 2,770 blocks north of the farm)?

sites.name: Odile Furrow, Produce Buyer
sites.why: south-east corner of Hollin's farm stall (stall footprint local -8..-4, -14..-10), two columns west of the avenue's paving (x -1..1), facing east across it like the stall keeper. 5.4 blocks from the stall merchant, 32 from the farmer. expected_at is tools/apricorn_farm.py spot() at this local cell on 2026-10-10; tools/produce_buyer.py check recomputes it and fails on drift
sites.greeting: Crates, not handfuls. I buy what farms grow, and I pay less as your badges grow: a trainer with a purse doesn't need my coin. So much a stretch of road, then wait for your next badge.

schedule.why: ECONOMY_OVERHAUL 2.2's table: the price per crate and the crates a player may sell in a leg, by badges held. Leg income shares there are COMPUTED by that design, not here
schedule.campaign_cap_why: the sum over legs of price x crates: 1,600 + 900 + 500 + 200 + 4 x 100 = 3,600 per player; tools/produce_buyer.py check recomputes it and fails if it differs

audit_checklist: the allowance resets on every change of the badge count and at no other time, per player (cob_pb_leg against the count of cobblers:flag/gymN_cleared)
no path pays more than the schedule's price for the badges held, and none pays before the crate is taken; every pay is followed by the balance check

no seller in the world (data/markets.json, Hollin's stall, the traders' templates, defaultShop, donor merchants) sells a crate item at or under its crate's top price / count per unit (40/16 = $2.50 for a 16-crate, $1.25 for a 32-crate, $0.625 for a 64-crate): buying a crate to sell it would pay inside the allowance
